title: Emotional support for young people
intro: Research into young people’s emotional support needs during the cost of living crisis informs co-designed wellbeing activities for young people and families.

blocks.heading: Thriving Together
paragraphs: For young people aged 14–22 in Tower Hamlets and their families, youth-led workshops focus on community connections, stress management, emotional resilience, money management and peer learning.

blocks.heading: What the first phase explored
paragraphs: Young people and parents or carers helped co-design workshops on mental health, financial wellbeing, resilience and communication. Peer researchers helped ensure activities reflected participants’ experiences.

blocks.heading: Take part
paragraphs: To find out about current opportunities, contact research@toynbeehall.org.uk.
